The method

Revenue is only the starting point.

Every calculator separates sale revenue, percentage fees, fixed charges, item cost, shipping, and other expenses. You can see the formula, change assumptions, and understand unusual results.

Learn how profit is calculated →
1Enter the dealUse the price and costs you genuinely expect.
2Check the returnReview dollars, margin, and ROI together.
3Stress-test itTry a lower offer or higher cost before deciding.
